title: Grid System & Layouts
slide_intent: Signal the move from individual ingredients to composition because readers need to know when rules concern relationships between elements.
strategic_value: The familiar orange divider can connect Burger King’s structural guidance to the same expressive identity it organizes.
demonstration: Large brown GRID SYSTEM & LAYOUTS lettering sits on two lines near the top of an orange page.
practical_value: Recognize this as a section boundary before the margin and placement instructions.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Place the large two-line title at upper left.

content_islands.name: Navigation and rights
content_islands.spec: Keep small running labels above and the rights notice at bottom left.
